environment.cache_state: OS filesystem cache warm in every test; reopened_connection drops application/SQLite connection caches, not OS caches
environment.timing: Wall time; not a separate CPU, physical IO or application frame-rate measurement

comparison.baseline: pre-fix 0.2.153 data_store implementation rebuilt with the same paired benchmark
comparison.order: entire baseline executable then updated executable; within each workload JSON/SQLite order alternates for identical values
comparison.json_durability: read/compare existing file, serialize, temporary file write, sync_all, atomic rename, parent directory sync
comparison.sqlite_durability: WAL + synchronous=FULL; wal_autocheckpoint=512; automatic checkpoints included in write timings
comparison.sqlite_page_cache: baseline default; updated bounded 8192 KiB per connection
comparison.limits: One cached snapshot per connection; changing snapshot or a competing writer can require general reconciliation. No claim that all full snapshot writes beat JSON.

methodology.data: deterministic synthetic records in a temporary directory
methodology.hot: repeated writes on one connection; OS filesystem cache warm
methodology.reopened: connection/write cache cleared before timing; OS filesystem cache remains warm
methodology.write_inputs: identical successive values, alternating backend order
methodology.write_timers: serialization plus durable persistence; mutation excluded equally
